name: ollama
notes: Context length cannot be relied on through /v1. Set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH before `ollama serve` (or bake num_ctx into a Modelfile) to at least the largest prompt in the scenario; report.py flags requests the server truncated.
Concurrency is a server setting: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL (slots per model) and OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS. Record the values you ran with.
The unload hook uses Ollama's native API (keep_alive: 0); it is the only non-OpenAI call in this profile.
